methodology_notes: Item 1: I counted a single stated NOT VERIFIED as satisfying the tri-state item, since it is one of the three named outcomes, even though W and X do not enumerate the other two. A stricter judge could say only a visible three-way scheme counts. Item 6 for Y and Z: their clean axes quote the relevant code and trace the outcome, and neither labels this a receipt. I gave credit because the trace shows how the axis was checked and is more than a bare "PASS". A stricter reading would mark both absent. Item 5 for W and X: each suggests a fix in a sentence (clamp to 2147483647; use isSafeInteger) without supplying a corrected implementation. I counted that as refraining. Item 4 for Y and Z: Z lists a single defect and Y's discrepancies are in contract order, so neither ranks defects by severity. The "_" key in W, X, Y and Z is an empty stray field and can be ignored.
